user_journey: In-Trip Safety, SOS Emergency & Night-Shift Logout
owner: Safety & Security Product + Mobile Engineering + Fleet Operations
ease_rationale: Moderate (3/5): Client UI changes (non-blocking SOS access, trip-cancel confirmation dialog) are fast; operational helpline/escort SLA enforcement requires ops coordination [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: Users report SOS button failures or popups obstructing SOS access, unreachable emergency helplines (Sahayta), session logouts during active trips preventing urgent reporting, lack of confirmation calls before marking night-shift female commuters as no-show, and rash/unsafe driving.
root_cause_hypothesis: 1) Full-screen modal overlays rendered above the persistent SOS action bar; 2) Aggressive auth token expiry disconnecting active trip views in low-network zones; 3) Operational gaps in vendor night-shift escort and helpline staffing.
telemetry_check: Audit SOS button tap-to-dispatch success rate, modal z-index hierarchy on active trip screens, Sahayta helpline call drop/wait times, and night-shift no-show call logs.

theme_name: App Crashes, Launch Freezes & Post-Update Failures
user_journey: App Update, Cold Launch & Core Runtime Stability
ease_rationale: Moderate (3/5): Standard Android crash-trace debugging and defensive local storage/cache migration handling within 1-2 sprints [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: App fails to open after updates, closes immediately on launch, hangs on loading screens even with strong internet, or stops working every few days until the user uninstalls and reinstalls the app.
root_cause_hypothesis: Corrupted local Room/SQLite state or unmigrated shared-preferences cache during in-place Play Store upgrades, plus unhandled network/JSON exceptions on cold start.
telemetry_check: Compare Firebase Crashlytics / Sentry crash-free cold-start rates for upgrade installs vs. clean installs across Android OS versions (including Android 15/16/17) and device OEMs.

theme_name: Schedule Sync Bugs, Unfair 'No-Show' Penalties & Booking Cutoffs
user_journey: Shift Scheduling, Roster Modification, Check-In & Desk/Shuttle Booking
ease_rationale: Moderate (3/5): Fixing empty schedule list rendering, adding AM/PM format clarity, and alerting users before auto-canceling return trips are 1-2 sprint fixes [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: Booked schedules fail to render in the app (showing blank/empty state despite travel desk confirmation); users are unfairly marked 'No-Show' when cabs arrive early/late, triggering automatic cancellation of their return logout trip or 3-strike account suspension; shuttle and workspace seat/parking booking flows require excessive steps.
root_cause_hypothesis: 1) Pagination/date-filter bug in schedule list API response handling; 2) Lack of push/SMS warning when a morning 'No-Show' cascades into auto-canceling the evening logout cab.
telemetry_check: Inspect API response vs. UI render logs for `/schedule` endpoints, audit 'No-Show' dispute rates when driver GPS is >200m from pickup pin, and track return-trip auto-cancellation rates.

theme_name: Routing Detours, Unreliable ETAs & Excessive Commute Times
user_journey: Route Optimization, Cab Allocation & Commute Execution
owner: Routing & Dispatch Algorithms Team + Client Transport Operations
ease_rationale: Hard (2/5): Tuning multi-stop route solver constraints and ETA prediction models across multi-tenant fleet rules requires algorithmic & ops validation [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: Cabs arrive 45–60+ minutes late or are scheduled 1.5–2 hours before shift start for short rides; ETAs fluctuate wildly; routing algorithm clubs passengers from far-apart zones into circuitous detours; passenger sequence on employee app mismatches driver app.
root_cause_hypothesis: 1) Over-aggressive vehicle capacity utilization parameters in the routing solver; 2) Static travel-time matrices underestimating peak-hour congestion; 3) Sync lag between backend roster re-sequencing and passenger/driver client caches.
telemetry_check: Compare predicted ETA vs. actual arrival timestamps (ETA error distribution), audit detour ratios (pooled trip time vs. direct trip time), and check sequence sync latency between passenger and driver apps.

theme_name: Mandatory Ride Rating Walls, Intrusive Popups & Forced Permissions
user_journey: Post-Ride Feedback, App Launch Modals & OS Permission Prompts
ease_rationale: Very Easy (5/5): Adding a 'Skip/Dismiss' button to post-ride rating modals and removing non-essential blocking permission/banner gates requires minimal UI/config work [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: Users report being locked out of booking or viewing schedules until they rate their previous ride (with no 'Skip' option), intrusive full-screen launch banners/popups, broken seatbelt verification popups hiding boarding OTPs, and forced microphone/auto-timezone/notification permissions.
root_cause_hypothesis: Blocking modal product design intended to boost internal trip feedback compliance, which backfires by driving frustrated commuters to the Play Store to leave retaliatory 1-star ratings.
telemetry_check: Audit tenant-level and global feature flags for `mandatory_trip_feedback`, track modal abandonment/block rates, and inspect why `RECORD_AUDIO` (microphone) permission is requested.

theme_name: Authentication, Login OTP Delivery & Auto-Logout in Low Network
user_journey: Account Registration, SSO/OTP Login & Active Trip Session Persistence
ease_rationale: Easy-to-Moderate (4/5): Caching active trip details/OTP offline and extending session refresh grace periods are standard client-side resilience improvements [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: Users fail to receive login/registration OTPs via SMS or email, receive unhelpful error messages when their corporate ID is unmapped, or get automatically logged out when stepping into basement parking/low-network zones right as the cab arrives (losing access to cab number and boarding OTP).
root_cause_hypothesis: 1) Aggressive token validation that clears local session state upon transient HTTP/network timeouts instead of falling back to cached trip state; 2) SMS/email OTP gateway throttling.
telemetry_check: Measure login OTP delivery latency/failure rate by SMS provider, and audit client auth-interceptor code to verify whether `401` vs. network timeout triggers a forced logout.

theme_name: False 'Not Downloaded from Play Store' Integrity Lockout
ease_rationale: Easy (4/5): Localized fix in client installer-package / Play Integrity verification check and caching logic [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: Legitimate Play Store users are repeatedly blocked from opening the app with a false error stating the app was 'not downloaded/installed from the Google Play Store', forcing repeated uninstall/reinstall cycles every few days.
root_cause_hypothesis: Brittle `getInstallingPackageName` / `getInstallSourceInfo` check or transient Google Play Integrity API token failure when background auto-updates or enterprise MDM/work-profile updates occur.
telemetry_check: Log exact `InstallSourceInfo` package names (`com.android.vending`, OEM updaters, work profiles) and Play Integrity API error codes whenever the integrity block screen is triggered.

theme_name: Cluttered UI Navigation, Multi-Step Flows & Broken In-App Feedback
user_journey: Home Dashboard Navigation, Shuttle/Desk Selection & In-App Feedback
ease_rationale: Easy (4/5): Streamlining home screen actions, fixing broken feedback text inputs, and saving default floor/shift preferences are straightforward client UX improvements [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: Users find recent UI redesigns cluttered with too many dropdowns and clicks before reaching the main schedule/tracking view, complain that shuttle booking increased from 1 step to 2 steps, and report that the built-in feedback text box or routing feedback link is broken or missing.
root_cause_hypothesis: Feature bloat across commute, desk, meeting, and parking modules without persistent user defaults, plus regressions in the in-app feedback form component.
telemetry_check: Track time-to-first-action on app launch, funnel drop-off in the 2-step shuttle booking flow, and submission error rates on the in-app feedback view.

theme_name: Live Vehicle Tracking Freeze, GPS Inaccuracy & Map Auto-Zoom
owner: Maps, Real-Time Tracking & Driver App Engineering
ease_rationale: Moderate (3/5): Fixing map camera auto-zoom reset is an easy client fix; improving driver GPS telemetry freshness requires driver-app background location tuning [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: Vehicle location on the map freezes or lags by 15–60+ minutes, pickup home pins jump to wrong coordinates, shuttle live location disappears after updates, and the map camera forcibly resets zoom every 30 seconds to include the distant office destination.
root_cause_hypothesis: 1) Map camera `LatLngBounds` auto-fit timer overriding user pinch-zoom gestures; 2) Driver app (`com.moveinsync.driver.lite`) background GPS ping throttling or WebSocket/polling staleness.
telemetry_check: Measure P50/P95 staleness of driver GPS pings during active pickup windows and inspect client map viewport reset intervals when user interaction is detected.

theme_name: Driver Behavior, Vendor Fleet Quality & Unresponsive Helpdesk
user_journey: On-Ground Pickup, Ride Experience & Transport Helpdesk Escalation
owner: Fleet Operations, Vendor Management & Client Transport Helpdesk
ease_rationale: Hard (2/5): Operational driver discipline and client transport vendor SLAs lie largely outside mobile code, though in-app escalation and callback routing can be improved [PROVISIONAL].
symptom_summary: Drivers refuse pickups, do not answer calls, behave rudely, or operate poorly maintained vehicles without AC; when employees try to escalate, the transport helpdesk / customer care is unreachable or unhelpful.
root_cause_hypothesis: Third-party fleet vendor shortages and inadequate SLA enforcement at the client site level, compounded by slow helpdesk telephony routing inside the app.
telemetry_check: Correlate driver/vendor complaint rates by enterprise client site and vendor ID, and measure in-app 'Call Helpdesk' connection and resolution rates.
